correctness.rationale: Reconstructed normalization R_t(z)=integral (1+s z)^(-1)dmu and exact order-two moments (1,t,t²/2), over finite signed Borel measures with 0<a<b and t in [a,b]. For c=(a+b)/2, h=(b-a)/2, d=t-c, δ=t²/2 the proposed λ* branches use two-point center u/endpoint v or midpoint-positive/endpoints-negative three-point measures. Substitution verifies mass, first and second moments. Their dual quadratic q(s)=1−2((s−u)/ρ)^2 lies in [−1,1] throughout [a,b] by the phase inequality ρ≥max{|u−a|,|u−b|}; in the interior use center c and ρ=h. Equality at dual contact atoms proves optimality among all signed measures and uniqueness of weights. At transition one endpoint weight vanishes; endpoint t=a,b are covered. The symmetric result total variation 1+t²/h² follows by d=0. An independently written Fraction test examined 306 exact rational triples, 38 outer and 268 inner, and verified the symmetric benchmark 26 at t=1,h=1/5. This finite test corroborates, not proves the continuum theorem.
